en: Only windows of apps you act on come over; windows opened by scripts or by someone at the other Mac stay there, and no longer land on the virtual display.
The other Mac gets its own microphone back as the default input after a session, even when it had been stuck on the AnyRemote Microphone.
zh-Hans: 只有你操作的 App 打开的窗口才会过来；脚本或对方 Mac 上的人打开的窗口留在那里，也不会再跑到虚拟显示器上。
会话结束后，对方 Mac 的默认输入会换回它自己的麦克风，之前一直停在 AnyRemote Microphone 上的情况也会恢复。
